sections: Protect empty space before you desperately need it. Keep one evening free, stop scheduling over lunch, or leave a little room between commitments. The goal is not another perfect routine. It is to stop treating every open space as a problem that must be filled.

Rest can also include joy: cooking slowly, reading fiction, visiting someone who makes you feel uncomplicated, taking photos, gardening, swimming, or walking without a destination. Rest often reconnects you with a version of yourself that exists outside performance.
